title: review-run meta.review_run object
description: The value of the draft's meta.review_run key (the draft's meta object holds exactly that one key). Every text field is untrusted, and meta is untrusted text downstream. A consumer treats coverage.status partial, code_run.status skipped (when it expected output), head_moved true, session.sandbox other than required, session.tools_checked false and a non-zero session.tools_unexpected as reasons not to act automatically.

skill_version.description: The bundled plugin's version for the default skill, else null.

skill_checked.description: true when the skill check ran (headless); false when it did not (interactive, with the run warning skill_unchecked).

sandbox.description: The session sandbox level from settings.json.

profile.description: bundled, variant (the bundled profile without the Agent and Task denies) or custom (a configured permission_profile).

tools_checked.description: true when the init tools list was compared with the pinned set (headless run, bundled profile or its variant).

tools_unexpected.description: How many tools outside the pinned set the init list held; never their names. 0 when the tools were not checked.

session.description: The session posture, from the run's settings.json and permission-profile.json and finalize step 5.

items.description: Untrusted: a short reason, one line.

risk_reasons.description: Untrusted: the session's reasons, at most 10 one-line strings of 1 to 200 characters.

summary.description: Untrusted: the session's summary, 1 to 2000 characters.

head_at_end.description: null when the end-of-run read failed.

head_moved.description: null when the end-of-run read failed.
